thread:
andrew: Weird dashboard behavior: p95 jumps on generate for ap-south but p50/p75 steady. Anyone else?
tess: Which widget + query? can you paste the console query?
andrew: widget: latency-over-time, query: `service=generate env=prod region=ap-south percentile=95 rollup=route_rollup`
nora: If rollup collapses `sample_origin` we can get a single blended percentile that hides the per-origin distribution. p50 stable because most traffic is fast at edge, tail from an exit-node drags p95.
sam: Also check sample-weighting. Some rollups apply sample weights weirdly when merging tdigest shards. That can move high-percentile mass.
ops-bot: Rollout notice: fanout-experiment increased 45% -> 80% by @deploy-bot at 1765551300
tess: timeline aligns. Quick repro: show p50/p95 per `sample_origin` tag. Console should not show a single unlabeled p95 when provenance tags exist.
andrew: ran a pinned canary: `exit_node=single-in` p95=140ms, fanout p95=420ms. That nails exit-node tail + rollout.
nora: For short-term UX: change legend to "p95 (mixed origins)" and add a small breakdown table underneath. Longer-term: preserve provenance in rollups or compute percentiles per origin before merging.
sam: I'll look at the aggregator codepath. If tdigest shards are merged without origin keys, we need to attach provenance histograms.
andrew: opened ops ticket and linked the chart. tagging as priority-high since SLO alert tripped.
ops-bot: SLO alert: generate.p95 > 250ms in ap-south (1765551365)
tess: good catch. I'll add runbook note: "do not rely on single-number percentiles when origin tags are collapsed" and add a lint to console queries to warn when rollup+percentile+origin-keys mismatch.
andrew: thanks, will coordinate rollback if tail worsens. :thumbsup:
